title: Instructor - Artificial Intelligence(AI)
description:
Job Description
  
  
Responsible for delivering practical and industry-oriented training in Artificial Intelligence, ensuring students understand both the concepts and their real-world applications. The trainer should mentor students through hands-on projects, assignments, and practical exercises while maintaining an engaging and supportive learning environment.
  
  
Key Responsibilities
  
  
Conduct classroom and practical sessions on Artificial Intelligence and related technologies.
  
Explain AI concepts in a simple, structured, and application-oriented manner.
  
Train students in relevant tools, platforms, programming concepts, and AI applications.
  
Guide students through hands-on projects, case studies, assignments, and practical exercises.
  
Keep course content updated with emerging AI tools, technologies, and industry trends.
  
Assess student performance and provide individual guidance and feedback.
  
Assist students in developing projects suitable for portfolios and career opportunities.
  
Coordinate with the Centre Manager regarding batch schedules, attendance, student progress, and course completion.
  
Maintain professional standards in classroom and lab sessions.
  
Technical Skills
  
  
Strong understanding of Artificial Intelligence and Generative AI.
  
Good knowledge of Python programming and AI/ML fundamentals.
  
Familiarity with Machine Learning, Deep Learning, NLP, and AI applications.
  
Knowledge of popular AI tools and platforms such as ChatGPT, Gemini, Claude, Copilot, etc.
  
Understanding of Prompt Engineering and AI-assisted productivity.
  
Ability to work with AI/ML libraries and practical development environments.
  
Basic understanding of Data Analytics, APIs, databases, and cloud/AI platforms is an advantage.
